caption: The drawing depicts a bedroom with blue vertically-striped wallpaper featuring floral accents at the top border. In the center is a brass-framed canopy bed with yellow drapes, a yellow and green bedspread, and several pillows, including two blue and one green. A guitar hangs at the head of the bed. Next to the bed, there is a wooden bedside table with a potted plant and a pink upholstered rocking chair. There is a full-length wooden mirror standing on the left side near a window with white lace curtains and yellow valances. The floor is covered in a green floral-patterned carpet. At the foot of the bed, there is a blue and white cushioned bench. On the right side of the room is a wooden dresser with an attached mirror, holding a blue glass lamp, some smaller items, and a vase of flowers. In front of the dresser, there is a small rectangular rug in pastel colors. Next to the dresser is a round table draped with a rose-colored, patterned cloth, on which sits a yellow lamp. Beside this table is a yellow wicker chair. The walls have pictures and framed portraits, some with ornate frames, and there is an additional sconce and some decorative objects on the walls. The ceiling is light yellow with a detailed pattern.
title: Woman's Bedroom
